params.body:
Replaces #983, which failed only the style check on two new test files. Same code, the new tests formatted with Pint.

Nine findings fixed in one branch so they can be tested together on the preview site, plus a partial fix for a tenth. Each section below was built and tested on its own and then combined; the full suite and PHPStan ran once more on the combined branch.

## Orders and their documents (#575, #582, #593)

**Extras on update and from an offer (R S4-4.10).** Only the direct create path synced extras correctly. `update` and `createFromOffer` ran their sync only while at least one extra was left, so removing every extra saved nothing; a removed extra was deleted by passing the whole collection instead of its id, so nothing was deleted either; and `array_filter` on each column separately shifted amounts and prices against the names when a row was blank or an amount was 0. All three paths now call one `syncExtras()`. That also makes the direct create path parse prices through `convertPrice`, as the other two already did, so "1.250,50" no longer reaches the float column as a string.

**Client block without a dealer logo (R S4-5.1).** The customer's name, address, email and the document number sat inside the dealer-logo condition. A dealer without a logo sent order forms with no customer on them. The offer and loan headers had the same structure and are fixed the same way: the condition wraps only the logo.

**Spoticar warranty (R S4-2.7).** Page 1 of the Spoticar order sheet printed `vehicle->warranty`. It now prints the order's warranty through `Custom::extendedWarranty`, like the regular order form, falling back to the vehicle only for an order that has none.

R S4-4.10 and R S4-2.7 move from `betwist` to `code`. R S4-5.1 stays `betwist`: the general terms finding on it is still open.

## The Stocklist gate and the Car-Pass warning (#583, #599)

The Stocklist gate (on stock, technically ready, a trade price) was checked on the sheet and in the buttons of the list row, but not where the write happens. `OwnStockList::putOnStocklist` and the classic route `OwnStockController::put_on_stocklist` set `available_on_stocklist` for any vehicle of the dealer, so a stale row or a direct call put a vehicle into the shared stock without the three (R S2-1.1, finding X-34).

- `Vehicle::canBeOnStocklist()` reads the gate on the saved row.
- The list action refuses a closed gate and says what is missing; the classic route returns false.
- The row menu now also asks for the trade price, like the step button already did.

The sheet showed no warning when portals were ticked on a vehicle without Car-Pass, while the list asks it as a question first (R S2-4.3, finding X-36). The existing text `send_to_modix_question_without_carpass` now stands under the portal boxes while one is ticked (or Nederland Mobiel) and the vehicle has no Car-Pass. It warns and does not block, like the Stocklist box (R S2-1.7).

Not changed: the Stocklist search (`VehicleRepository::extendedSearch`) still reads only `available_on_stocklist`. `VehicleApiService` puts a premium dealer's API vehicle on the Stocklist without the gate, and vehicles published before this change stay listed. Adding the gate to the search would take those vehicles off the Stocklist, which is a separate decision. The rule says so, and finding X-34 stays open on that question: this pull request refers to #583 but does not close it.

## The detail page in customer mode (#607, #629)

**The trade price is out of the page source in customer mode (X-104).** The prices on screen were already right, but the page source still carried the trade price twice:
- The customer-mode modal rendered its R S5-4.6 hint ("aankoopprijs: € 10 000,00") into the page.
- The buy-over confirmation text, which names the trade price, was rendered even when the button was hidden.

Now:
- The modal fetches the hint when it opens, from `GET stocklist/{vehicle_id}/client-mode-hint` (`StockListController::client_mode_hint`). That route has the same visibility as the detail page: published, sold, or the viewer's own vehicle, and a 404 otherwise.
- The confirmation text is only built where the buy-over button is shown, using the same condition as `buybox.blade.php`.

**The dead "sold" redirect is removed (X-63).** `StockListController::detail` had a branch that sent a sold vehicle back to the overview with a "sold" message. It could never run, because the guard before it already lets sold vehicles through. The detail page keeps showing sold vehicles. The visibility check is now one method shared by the detail page and the hint route.

Rules:
- R S5-4.3, R S5-4.6 and R S5-4.10 now say this.
- R S2-1.9 now says that a sold vehicle shows its detail. It cites the controller and the test, and its status moves from `betwist` to `code`.

## Cleanup (#650, #648, #625)

**Damage labels (#650).** `resources/lang/fr/damage.php` and `en/damage.php` carried test values for `Extra` (`'Extra fr'`, `'Extra eng'`). Both now read `Extra`. `en.extra_damage` already read `Extra damage` on main.

**Font picker (#648).** `settings/setting/index.blade.php` built the Google font picker on every settings page. A dealer without the Website tab (no right `website.index`) has no `#font-picker`, so the library threw `Missing div with id="font-picker"`. And a dealer without a stored font made it request `fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=%3Aregular`. Now the picker is built only when its div exists. An unset font falls back to Roboto, the stored default, and both values are written with `@js`. Pinned in `FontPickerOnlyWithTheWebsiteTabTest`.

**Dead VAT surcharge (#625).** `VehicleRealGarantService::getPrograms`, `OrderRealGarantService::getOrderContractOffer` and `RealGarantController::calculate` added 9.25% when `VATNeeded_select == 1`. `vehicles` has no such column or accessor (only `VATNeeded`), so the surcharge never applied. The line is removed from all three, so no price changes. The matching PHPStan baseline entry is removed. R S4-6.4 now states there is no surcharge, its sources are plain `code:` plus a decision record (`bronnen/beslissingen/2026-10-10-realgarant-zonder-btw-opslag.md`), and its status is `klant`.

## Checked

- New tests: `OrderExtrasAndDocumentHeaderTest` (5, all red on main), `TheStocklistGateHoldsOutsideTheSheetTest` (10), `FontPickerOnlyWithTheWebsiteTabTest` (2), and in `PriceOnScreenTest` and `StocklistDetailPreviewTest` the customer-mode source and the sold detail. `PriceOnScreenTest::in_customer_mode_the_trade_price_is_not_in_the_page` replaces the test that pinned the leak; SmokeTest visits the new hint route.
- Full suite on the combined branch: 3064 tests, no failures or errors (2 skipped, 1 incomplete, as on main). PHPStan: no errors.
- Not yet checked in a browser: the customer-mode hint when the modal opens, and the Car-Pass warning on the sheet.

Refs #583

Closes #575
Closes #582
Closes #593
Closes #599
Closes #607
Closes #629
Closes #650
Closes #648
Closes #625
params.title: Nine findings: order extras and headers, the Stocklist gate, the trade price out of customer mode, cleanup
